facts.value: Business English Courses (A-B-C-D)
In each semester, all courses are offered in parallel with the same level of difficulty (target level C1.1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages [CEFR]).
The fee-based course 'Business English Higher' is very suitable as preparation for the elective module courses in Business English.
Provisional admission for the qualification section of the bachelor exam according to §9 paragraph 5.
A two-stage application process with different deadlines is in effect. You must participate in both stages and pass the Online Qualifying Test.
Stage 1: Registration period: September 21, 2026 – October 5, 2026 via QIS.
Stage 2: Examination registration and deregistration deadlines: October 8, 2026 – October 21, 2026 via QIS.

Successful completion of a qualifying test at CEFR level B2.2, which takes place at the beginning of each semester if no bachelor elective module course in Business English has been successfully completed.

Exceptions: Students who have the Cambridge Certificate C1, a score of at least 100 points in the TOEFL test, or a score of at least 7.5 in the IELTS test must upload this language certificate in PDF format during the specified time slots for the Online Qualifying Test.
